summary: Alert, suspicious, unaware — with timed decay, so losing sight is not instant forgetting.
overview: Turns a momentary "can see" into believable awareness. Losing sight drops to suspicious after a delay and to unaware after another, rather than a guard forgetting you the instant you break line of sight.
useCases: Stealth guards that search where they last saw you.
An enemy that stays alert briefly after you break cover.
Driving alert music or UI from a named state.

params.tuning: How long full alert persists after losing sight. Too short and breaking line of sight feels like a cheat.
The search window. This is where a guard should be investigating the last known position.

gotchas.title: You have to tick it
gotchas.body: Decay happens in Tick, exposed so a self-test can drive it in exact increments without Play mode. Nothing decays if nobody calls it.
